name: TALOS
summary: A full-size torque-controlled research humanoid sold by Barcelona's PAL Robotics, with EtherCAT electronics, harmonic-drive joints and force-torque sensing at the wrists and ankles. It ships with a ROS software stack and a public URDF, and is used across European research projects for whole-body control and manipulation.
notable: ROS-native with an openly published robot model
